events.summary: Experience global music with the Stearns Collection of Musical Instruments. This free lunchtime concert features Persian santour player Alireza Fazel, alongside faculty and students, highlighting unique instruments from the collection.

evidence.venue: Cafeteria Auditorium, NCRC Building 18, 2800 Plymouth Rd, Ann Arbor, MI 48109
evidence.description: These free 45 minute programs highlight instruments from the collection and music from around the globe. This performance will feature Persian santour player Alireza Fazel, with Stearns Director Joseph Gascho and U-M Performing Arts Technology Associate Professor John Granzow and their students.
